name: singlet_clustering_subclustering
title: Subcluster one parent cluster
description: Splits the cells of one parent cluster into nested subclusters labelled <parent>.<k>. The default re-selects highly variable genes, denoises the PCA and rebuilds a graph on the subset; alternatives restrict the parent graph, run a permutation-tested split, or target a fixed count. It writes obs/<output_key> for the parent cells only. Do not use it to set dataset-wide granularity or to name cell types, and treat each subcluster as a hypothesis until a null check passes.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

parent.description: Parent cluster label or list of labels to subcluster; each must occur in obs/<parent_key>.

parent_key.description: obs column holding the parent labels; the default matches clustering.cell_partitioning.

output_key.description: Name of the output: writes obs/<output_key> and uns/<output_key>; replaced only when overwrite is true.

method.description: recompute_features re-selects genes and rebuilds the graph (default); graph_subset restricts the parent graph; choir_permutation tests splits; target_count fixes K.

layer.description: Raw counts layer; required by recompute_features and choir_permutation, unused by graph_subset and target_count.

min_cells.description: Parents with fewer cells keep their label; subclusters smaller than this return to the parent label.

seed.description: Random seed for graph clustering and permutation tests.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

recompute_features.description: Options for method recompute_features (scran quickSubCluster semantics).

n_top_features.description: Genes re-selected on the subset; scran uses the larger of 500 genes and 10 percent of genes, CHOIR 2000.

n_pcs.description: Principal components on the subset; null uses dim-reduction.pc_number_selection if present, else 30.

k_neighbors.description: Neighbours per cell in the subset graph.

denoise_pca.description: Denoise the subset PCA with the mean-variance trend, which assumes a homogeneous parent.

objective.description: Leiden quality function; CPM needs a resolution on the edge-weight scale (Section 3).

resolution.description: Leiden resolution; its meaning depends on the objective and on the subset size (Section 3).

graph_subset.description: Options for method graph_subset (Seurat FindSubCluster and scanpy restrict_to semantics).

graph_key.description: obsp key of the parent graph; must contain every parent cell.

objective.description: Leiden quality function; CPM needs a resolution on the edge-weight scale (Section 3).

resolution.description: Leiden resolution on the restricted graph; not comparable with the parent setting.

choir_permutation.description: Options for method choir_permutation (CHOIR subtree semantics).

alpha.description: Split significance level; adjusted per subtree as alpha/(4K) when p_adjust is bonferroni.

n_iterations.description: Label permutations per split comparison; run time grows with this value.

n_trees.description: Trees per random-forest classifier in the split test.

p_adjust.description: bonferroni applies the subtree adjustment; none uses alpha unchanged.

use_variance.description: Also require the permutation variance test to pass (CHOIR default).

countsplit.description: Split cells into two count halves so that feature selection and the test use disjoint data.

batch_key.description: obs column with a batch covariate for the subset embedding; null disables it.

target_count.description: Options for method target_count (pegasus split_one_cluster semantics).

n_subclusters.description: Requested number of subclusters; the output reports the realised count.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obs/subcluster. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Completed runs only. Keys: method, parents_processed, parents_split, subclusters_per_parent (parent label to count), returned_to_parent, objective, resolution.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
